subject: Propose 1-hr window: SOC 2 evidence deep-dive (encryption, SSO, audit logs)
messages:
From: Maya Rao <maya.rao@bridgepoint.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: time window for encryption and audit-logs deep-dive

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the recent demo — we had a great conversation about throughput and routing. Our security team would like to schedule a focused architecture deep-dive to validate SOC 2 evidence items before we move to a trial. The goal is a 60-minute call to cover:

- Encryption at rest + in-transit (KMS, key rotation, HSM integration)
- Audit logs: retention, integrity, access controls, and log shipping
- SSO / SAML config and SCIM provisioning
- Data flow diagrams / boundary scoping for PII-sensitive workloads

Do you have a 60-minute window in the next week? We are available:
- Tue 2026-11-09 10:00-11:00 PT
- Tue 2026-11-09 15:00-16:00 PT
- Wed 2026-11-10 09:00-10:00 PT

Please let me know who from your side should join (security engineer + infra/product owner recommended). I attached our lightweight SOC 2 evidence checklist for reference (SOC2_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf).

Thanks,
Maya Rao
Security Program Manager
Bridgepoint Health

(attachment: SOC2_evidence_checklist_v2.pdf)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
To: Maya Rao <maya.rao@bridgepoint.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com, dev_patel@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-11-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: time window for encryption and audit-logs deep-dive

Hi Maya — thanks, and glad the demo was helpful.

We can cover everything on your checklist in a 60-minute session. Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Marcus Lin (Security / Solutions) — meeting lead
- Lauren Bishop (Product Ops) — SOC 2 evidence owner
- Dev Patel (Infra / SRE) — audit logs, KMS/keys

Of the windows you listed, Nov 9 15:00-16:00 PT works best for us. If that’s still free on your end we’ll lock it.

A couple quick asks so we can prepare the right artifacts:
- Can you share any specific evidence IDs you want to review (e.g., log retention SLA, encryption KMS policies)?
- We’ll bring: data flow diagram, KMS config summary (redacted), sample audit-log slices (anonymized)
- If you prefer pre-reads, we can drop a short doc to your Drive link — please confirm access.

I’ll wait for your confirmation and will send a calendar invite once we’re aligned.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Rao <maya.rao@bridgepoint.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
Cc: security@bridgepoint.com
Date: 2026-11-07T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: time window for encryption and audit-logs deep-dive

Thanks Marcus — 15:00-16:00 PT on Tue Nov 9 is good for us. I’ll add our security architect (security@bridgepoint.com) to the invite.

For prep: please add a 1-page pre-read with the data flow diagram + brief KMS summary to this Drive folder and share with security@bridgepoint.com: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-secure-pre-read

We’d like to look at:
- KMS key policies and rotation cadence (high level — redacted configs OK)
- Audit log retention and where logs are stored/backed up
- SAML cert rotation process and onboarding checklist

I attached a short pre-read template that you can drop into the folder (bridgepoint-pre-read.md). Also, please include names/emails of anyone who will be allowed to download sample logs.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Maya

(attachment: bridgepoint-pre-read.md)

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com
To: Maya Rao <maya.rao@bridgepoint.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.example.com, dev_patel@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Calendar invite: SOC 2 evidence deep-dive — Tue Nov 9 15:00-16:00 PT

Folks — I’ve created the meeting and shared the Drive folder link. Invite attached (calendar-invite.ics).

Pre-meeting checklist (short):
- Marcus: upload data flow diagram + KMS summary to the folder by EOD Monday
- Dev: prepare 2 anonymized audit-log snippets and a short note on retention/backups
- Bridgepoint: confirm list of people who can access the sample logs (we’ll enable view/download for those accounts only)

We will not post any raw PII in the folder. Logs will be sanitized and delivered over a secure share during the meeting.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Product Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachment: calendar-invite.ics)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com
To: Maya Rao <maya.rao@bridgepoint.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com, dev_patel@redwood.example.com
Date: 2026-11-09T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Calendar invite: SOC 2 evidence deep-dive — Tue Nov 9 15:00-16:00 PT

Maya — confirming we’re all set for 3:00–4:00 PM PT today. Quick logistics and agenda below:

Agenda (60m):
1) 5m — intros and scope confirmation
2) 20m — encryption & KMS (key rotation, HSM integrations, access controls)
3) 20m — audit logs (retention policy, integrity checks, retrieval workflow)
4) 10m — SSO/SAML & next steps (evidence handoff timeline)

Deliverables we’ll upload before the call: data_flow_diagram_v1.pdf, kms-summary-redacted.pdf, audit-log-snippets-2.zip (sanitized). Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-secure-pre-read

If you need to move the meeting or want an extra hour, let me know; otherwise we’ll see you at 15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marcus
